blockingFindings.title: Explicit Proceed Skips Final Artifact Validation
blockingFindings.issue: `recordAndProceed()` no longer calls `validateFinalRegressionResult(json)` after applying explicit record-and-proceed fields. It only calls `validateExplicitFinalRegressionProceed()`, whose current checks do not replace the full result schema validation for fields outside the explicit evidence binding.
blockingFindings.suggestion: In `recordAndProceed()`, run `validateFinalRegressionResult(json)` before or after `validateExplicitFinalRegressionProceed({ root, artifact: json })`, and only write the artifact after both validations pass.
blockingFindings.rationale: R3 requires explicit failed-regression completion evidence, and the existing mandatory result validation is the guard that enforces the artifact contract as a whole. Replacing it with a narrower explicit-evidence validator can allow malformed completed artifacts to be persisted as report-ready evidence.
